chapter_title_en: The Emergence of the Demonic Shadow
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch.637: The Unkillable Shadow and the Three Sovereign Mirror
chapter_meta_description: An unkillable shadow from the stone gate wreaks havoc on the Ninety-Nine Stone Steps, forcing the Stone Man Kings to unite. Xiao Chen wields the Three Sovereign Mirror in a desperate gambit, but the Otherworld Ancestral Gods close in. A thrilling, horror-tinged chapter.
og_title: Ch.637: The Shadow That Cannot Die – World of Immortality
og_description: The stone gate opens, and a dark horror emerges. The kings ally under threat, and the Three Sovereign Mirror becomes the last hope. Xiao Chen is pushed to the brink.
twitter_description: The kings unite against an immortal shadow. Xiao Chen's Three Sovereign Mirror may be the only weapon, but the cost is becoming unbearable.
